newsitem.title: USA: FP&L St Lucie Fla. power plant fully back.
newsitem.headline: FP&L St Lucie Fla. power plant fully back.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co's St Lucie 2 nuclear power plant has returned to full power, as expected, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reported Thursday.

A company spokesman earlier this week said the 839 megawatt unit, at Hutchinson Island, Fla., likely would resume full production Wednesday after engineers completed scheduled turbine valve testing and inspection of its condenser.
Power generation at the plant was trimmed to about 70 percent of capacity during the tests.
FP&L's adjacent St Lucie 1 unit was unaffected by the work and is operating at its full 839 MW capacity, the NRC said.
Florida Power & Light is a subsidiary of the FP&L Group.
